# Paul Schelhaas

> Paul Schelhaas is a multi-patent inventor and former CEO who helps security,
> energy and industrial businesses commercialise new technology, protect their
> intellectual property and win major customers. His site positions this around a
> single promise: turning innovation into revenue.

Paul works with founders, boards and leadership teams, typically on a fractional
or advisory basis. He combines hands-on technical and systems-engineering depth
with commercial and IP strategy, drawing on having built and scaled Sunstone IP
Systems, invented granted patents and shipped equipment into global blue-chip
customers.

- [Bespoke build](https://www.paulschelhaas.com/#bespoke): tailored, project-based support
- [Contact](https://www.paulschelhaas.com/#contact): how to get in touch

## Capabilities

- Fractional Chief Innovation Officer
- Innovation and Commercialisation Strategy
- IP Strategy and Patent Portfolio
- Technical Design and Systems Engineering
- Board Advisory and Non-Executive Director roles
- Diligence and Dispute Support
